# Website fonts

Self-hosted Latin WOFF2 subsets. No visitor requests go to a font service.

- Bricolage Grotesque, variable normal 400-700 (optical size 12-96).
- Newsreader, variable normal and italic 400-600 (optical size 6-72).

Downloaded from the Google Fonts CSS distribution on 2026-09-07. Upstream
sources and SIL Open Font License notices:

- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/bricolagegrotesque
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/newsreader

The corresponding OFL files are distributed with the public font assets.
The subsets are supplied by Google Fonts, not modified locally. Keep code
and HTTP examples in the existing system monospace stack.
